required_fixes: Re-extract WebArena AX trees for >=15 tasks stratified across >=10 families with 2 tasks per family where family size >=2 via CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree at 1280x720 initial viewport to compute AX_consistency per spec measurement_validity #4 and prereg 5.4; current ax_consistency=null from REUSED 10 trees (1 per family, label REUSED) makes frozen clause 1 threshold (>=0.6) untestable and decision_rule was relaxed to PARTIAL without justification.

Reimplement Mind2Web mechanism per frozen spec.json/prereg 5.2: TF-IDF on (task + action target text) -> k-means k=min(50, unique_tasks/20) fitted on train only then applied to test, with frozen seed 35725763380 and no test leakage; fallback to (action_type, verb_lemma) bigram only if clustering unstable. Current code uses coarse keyword heuristic (action_type-target_role-verb_lemma with ~33 distinct train mechanisms) and never executes TF-IDF/k-means.

Use official Mind2Web splits train/test_task/test_website/test_domain from HuggingFace revision (or official data/*.json) instead of synthetic random website partition. Current extract_mind2web_mechanisms() ignores any HF test splits (dataset has only train with 1009 tasks in this environment) and fabricates train/test_website by random 60/40 website shuffle (shuffled_sites = sorted websites random shuffle) and random domain shuffle, so reported overlap 0.7407 is not the frozen test_website overlap.

Fix shuffle null B4/NC2 to permute website assignment across train+test_website and recompute overlap per spec/prereg 5.5(4) (1000 perms, seed 35725763380, mean/std and 95th percentile). Current compute_shuffle_null() shuffles mechanism labels and chooses random split_point = randint(1, n_train), yielding high null_mean 0.6942 that reflects coarse label distribution not website identity.

Resolve and pin Mind2Web dataset divergence: spec claims 137 websites/31 domains but HF osunlp/Mind2Web in this environment has 73 websites/3 domains (1009 tasks, single split train) per provenance.json and audit recomputation; record dataset revision hash, download date, and explain divergence (e.g., HF revision vs paper docs vs subset). Do not silently substitute synthetic partition for official splits.

Record Mind2Web dataset revision hash and bootstrap CIs for overlap/parameterization per spec; current provenance reports dataset_revision unknown and overlap CIs not computed. Document k sensitivity (k/2 and 2k) per prereg validity disclosure.

Re-evaluate decision_rule strictly: with ax_consistency=null clause 1 is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING per frozen rule (requires >=0.6), not PARTIAL; infrastructure availability (docker_available true, playwright_installed false) does not convert missing measurement into PASS. Report clause 1 as not demonstrably viable until AX re-extracted.

claim_ceiling: WebArena-Verified v2 single-store substrate quantitatively supports parameterized family structure: 192 tasks, 49 intent_templates, 36 families with >=3 tasks (34 with >=4, 33 with >=5), duplication 0.9479 with exact_copy 0.0781 and param_task 0.8958 (all thresholds quantitatively met). However within-store same-mechanism AX consistency (same intent_template -> same element pattern) is UNMEASURED (ax_consistency=null, 10 REUSED trees 1 per family); therefore identifiable same-mechanism parameterized transfer for C-LLM-INHERIT is not yet demonstrated at the element-pattern level, only at the template-count level. PC1 search presence PASS is via reuse, not live re-extraction. C-LLM-INHERIT remains HYPOTHESIS/EXPERIMENTAL, bounded to quantitative census substrate only; no LLM agent inheritance benefit, retrieval comparison, or checkout execution was tested. Mind2Web: on the coarse action_type-target_role-verb_lemma clustering and synthetic 60/40 website partition, cross-website overlap 0.7407 does NOT exceed shuffled null by >=0.10 (excess 0.0466, null_mean 0.6942, p95 0.8929) so same-mechanism cross-website transfer is not demonstrated IN THIS MEASUREMENT. Because mechanism was coarse (33 distinct) and partition synthetic, this negative does NOT falsify Mind2Web true cross-website overlap on official train/test_website splits with spec-compliant clustering; it is inconclusive for C-CROSSSITE website-holdout design. Maximum justified carry-forward: quantitative within-store family reuse established with disclosed parameterization vs copy decomposition; cross-store 12-store design remains impossible; Mind2Web measurable same-mechanism overlap remains UNKNOWN pending spec-compliant remeasurement; AX verification remains UNKNOWN.
